rules.statement: Costs in a partition action are not a first charge on the land to be partitioned or on the divided portions after partition, but they are payable by the individuals taking part in the partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: They, do not appear to be a charge on the land to be partitioned or on the divided portions after partition, but to be sums payable by the individuals taking part in the partition action, so that when a writ issues for costs, the property belonging to the individual liable to pay may be seized and sold in execution in the ordinary way without there being any charge on the land.
